description: Signalisation verticale - Support is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Kanton Genf. Cette couche représente les supports des signaux de la signalisation verticale règlementant la circulation. Ils indiquent la position géographique exacte des panneaux et plaquettes. La totalité de la signalisation verticale est composé de 3 couches (supports, signaux et plaquettes) qui sont regroupées dans le groupe de couches 'PANNEAUX DE SIGNALISATION ROUTIERE'. Coverage: Kanton Genf. The portal files it under the publisher Kanton Genf. It offers 9 resource(s) in API, CSV, GML, KML, SHP. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
